actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dark Stare
actions.description: The bloody bones stares balefully at one creature it can see within 60 feet. That creature must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on all attacks until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Its Crown Runs Red
reactions.description: When it is hit by an attack, the bloody bones regains 5 (1d10) hit points and has resistance to that damage type until the end of its next turn as life-giving blood pours from the top of its skull.

monsters.name: Bookkeeper
monsters.speed: 20 ft., fly 30 ft. (while within the book)
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
damage_immunities: either cold or fire (designated at the time of the bookkeeper's creation)
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 11
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

features.name: Between the Lines
features.description: As a bonus action while within 30 feet of its book, the bookkeeper can hop inside its book. While inside its book, the bookkeeper has a flying speed of 30 feet and is indistinguishable from ink on a page.

features.name: Book Bound
features.description: A bookkeeper makes all attacks, saving throws, and skill checks with advantage when its creator is within 60 feet of its book. The bookkeeper's hp maximum is reduced by 1 for every minute it is further than 60 feet from its book. When its hp maximum reaches 0, it dies. If its creator dies, the bookkeeper can be convinced to pass ownership of the book to a new creature if the creature succeeds on a DC 13 Charisma check. The new owner becomes the bookkeeper's new "creator" and inherits the bookkeeper along with the book.

features.name: Disintegrate
features.description: When the bookkeeper dies, the book it is bound to is also destroyed.

actions.name: Ink Splash
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) poison damage and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 1 poison damage.

actions.name: Elusive Pages
actions.description: While inside its book, the bookkeeper magically turns its book invisible until it attacks, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). The bookkeeper is also invisible while inside the invisible book

monsters.name: Boot Grabber
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 13
languages: understands Void Speech but can't speak

features.name: Adhesive
features.description: The boot grabber adheres to anything that touches it. A Large or smaller creature adhered to the boot grabber is also grappled by it (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.

features.name: Amorphous
features.description: The boot grabber can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

features.name: False Appearance
features.description: While the boot grabber remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a dirty puddle of water.

actions.name: Adhesive Hands
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is subjected to its Adhesive trait. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the boot grabber can't make adhesive hands attacks against other targets.

actions.name: Unearthly Hum
actions.description: The boot grabber targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. It emits a high frequency humming noise which can only be heard by the target. The target must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or move toward the boot grabber on its turn by the shortest and most direct route, ending its turn when it comes within 5 feet of the boot grabber.

features.name: Gem Illumination
features.description: As a bonus action, the carbuncle can cause its garnet to glow or not. While glowing, the garnet sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

features.name: Jungle Camouflage
features.description: The carbuncle has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in jungle terrain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The carbuncle makes one bite attack and one claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Light Beam (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The carbuncle shoots a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line of scintillating light from the garnet on its forehead. Each creature in that line must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

features.name: Feline Terror
features.description: Each creature in the swarm must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or fall prone and become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the swarm's Feline Terror for the next 24 hours.

features.name: Keen Senses
features.description: The swarm has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, hearing, or smell.

features.name: Swarm
features.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny cat. The swarm can't regain hp or gain temporary hp.

actions.name: Bites
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., up to two creatures in the swarm's space. Hit: 14 (4d6) piercing damage, or 7 (2d6) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer.

monsters.name: Cauldronborn
damage_resistances: piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with adamantine

features.name: Consumption
features.description: As a bonus action, a cauldronborn can consume one potion within 5 feet of it that is not being worn or carried. Along with the potion's effect, the cauldronborn's hp maximum increases by 3 (1d6) and it gains the same number of hp.

features.name: Detect Elixir
features.description: The cauldronborn can pinpoint the location of potions and magic items within 60 feet of it. Outside of 60 feet, it can sense the general direction of potions within 1 mile of it.

features.name: Regeneration
features.description: The cauldronborn regains 2 hp at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hp.

features.name: Sprint
features.description: The cauldronborn triples its speed until the end of its turn when moving toward a potion it has detected.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cauldronborn makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Call Potion (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The cauldronborn releases a hungry screech, magically reaching out to nearby potions. All potions within 10 feet of the cauldronborn magically move toward the cauldronborn by rolling out of backpacks, hopping off of belts, unburying themselves, etc. A creature wearing or carrying a potion must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or its potion moves to within 5 feet of the cauldronborn. The target must make a separate saving throw for each potion it is attempting to keep in its possession.

features.name: Charge
features.description: If the centaur moves at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a pike attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 14 (4d6) piercing damage.

features.name: Leadership (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
features.description: For 1 minute, the centaur chieftain can utter a special command or warning whenever a nonhostile creature that it can see within 30 feet of it makes an attack roll or a saving throw. The creature can add a d4 to its roll provided it can hear and understand the centaur chieftain. A creature can benefit from only one Leadership die at a time. This effect ends if the centaur chieftain is incapacitated.

features.name: Rearing Strike (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: The centaur chieftain rears back on its hind legs and makes a powerful stomp with its hooves. Each creature within 15 feet of the chieftain must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The attack leaves the centaur chieftain vulnerable, reducing its Armor Class by 2 until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The centaur chieftain makes two attacks: one with its pike and one with its hooves or two with its longbow.

actions.name: Pike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

features.name: Acid Touch
features.description: As an action, the child of Yggdrasil destroys one nonmagical object that isn't being worn or carried, such as a rope, plank, candlestick, or even an entire bronze cauldron.

features.name: Forest Camouflage
features.description: The child of Yggdrasil has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in forest terrain.

features.name: Keen Smell
features.description: The child of Yggdrasil has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The child of Yggdrasil makes three claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

features.name: Feybane
features.description: Creatures of the fey type don't recover spells during a long rest while within 60 feet of the chuhaister. In addition, the chuhaister automatically sees through magical illusions created by spells of 3rd level or lower and has advantage on saving throws and ability checks to detect or see through illusion spells of 4th level or higher.

features.name: Light Sensitivity
features.description: While in bright light, the chuhaister has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The chuhaister makes two greatclub attacks.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (5d6+6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 33 (5d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Deadfall Shield (Recharge 5-6)
reactions.description: When the chuhaister or one ally within 30 feet of it is hit by an attack, the chuhaister can create a magical, wooden barrier that interrupts the attack. The attack causes no damage. The shield splinters and disappears afterwards.

features.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
features.description: The chupacabra has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

features.name: Running Leap
features.description: With a 10-foot running start, the chupacabra can long jump up to 25 feet.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the chupacabra attaches to the target. While attached, the chupacabra doesn't attack. Instead, at the start of each of the chupacabra's turns, the target loses 6 (1d6 + 3) hp due to blood loss. The chupacabra can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. It does so after the target is reduced to 0 hp. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the chupacabra.

actions.name: Fearful Gaze
actions.description: The chupacabra fixes its gaze on one creature it can see within 10 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A paralyzed creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the chupacabra's Fearful Gaze for the next 24 hours.

reactions.name: Malodorous Stench
reactions.description: When the chupacabra is reduced to less than half of its maximum hp, it releases a foul, sulphurous stench. Each creature within 5 feet of the chupacabra must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Assassinate
features.description: During its first turn, the assassin has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit the assassin scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

features.name: Explosive Core
features.description: When the assassin is destroyed, its core explodes, projecting superheated steam and shrapnel. Each creature within 5 feet of the construct must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

features.name: Immutable Form
features.description: The assassin is immune to any spell or effect, other than its disassembly trait, that would alter its form.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The assassin has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Psychic Susceptibility
features.description: If the assassin takes psychic damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
features.description: The assassin deals an extra 10 (3d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the assassin that isn't incapacitated and the assassin doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

features.name: Standing Leap
features.description: The assassin's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The clockwork assassin makes two rapier attacks.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 11 (2d10) poison damage and be poisoned for 1 minute.

actions.name: Disassembly
actions.description: The assassin breaks its body down into a snakelike, segmented cylinder, which allows it to move through a space as narrow as 6 inches wide. It can reassemble itself into its true form by using this action again. While disassembled into its snake form, the assassin can't attack and attack rolls against it have advantage.

features.name: Domestic Retainer
features.description: The servant can cast the mending and prestidigitation cantrips at will without requiring spell components.

features.name: Immutable Form
features.description: The servant is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The servant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Immutable Form
features.description: The soldier is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

features.name: Intimidating Legions
features.description: A single clockwork soldier's rigid movements appear silly, but, when gathered in numbers, they become an inhuman terror. When the clockwork soldier makes a Charisma (Intimidation) check, it gains a bonus on that check equal to the number of other clockwork soldiers the target can see or hear.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The soldier has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Halberd
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Overdrive Flurry (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The soldier makes four halberd attacks. After taking this action, it is stunned until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Object Reading
features.description:
By concentrating for 10 minutes on a specific object, a corpse thief learns more about the object's most recent owner. The effects of this trait are different depending on if the most recent owner is alive or dead. This trait only works once per object.
• If the most recent owner is alive, the corpse thief sees through that person's eyes for 10 minutes. This works like the clairvoyance spell, except the most recent owner is the sensor and controls which direction it is pointed, how far it can see, etc. The most recent owner must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a success, it gets the sensation that it is being watched.
• If the most recent owner is dead, the corpse thief can learn five things about the person's life through dream-like visions and emotions. This works like the speak with dead spell, except the spirit can only answer questions about events in which the object was present.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The corpse thief makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Steal
actions.description: The corpse thief targets one creature within 5 feet of it and attempts to steal one small item. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or lose one non-weapon, non-armor object that is small enough to fit in one hand.

monsters.name: Crimson Mist
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
languages: understands all languages it knew as a vampire, but can't speak

features.name: Pseudocorporeal
features.description: The crimson mist is weightless and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing.

features.name: Sanguine Feast
features.description: Whenever the crimson mist deals necrotic damage to a living creature with blood in its body, the creature's hp maximum is reduced by the same amount and the mist regains hp equal to half the necrotic damage dealt. The reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. The creature dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

features.name: Vampire Weaknesses
features.description: The crimson mist has the following flaws: Forbiddance. The crimson mist can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants. Harmed by Running Water. The crimson mist takes 20 force damage if it ends its turn above or within running water. Sunlight Hypersensitivity. The crimson mist takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

features.name: Undead Nature
features.description: The crimson mist doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.description: The mist moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter a Medium or smaller creature's space. When the mist enters a creature's space, the creature must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, the creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the mist. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw. On a failed save, the mist enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 15 (4d6) necrotic damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, is restrained, and takes 15 (4d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of the mist's turns. When the mist moves, the engulfed creature doesn't move with it, and is freed. An engulfed creature can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 14 Strength check. On a success, the creature escapes and enters a space of its choice within 5 feet of the mist. A creature within 5 feet of the mist can take an action to pull a creature out of the mist. Doing so requires a DC 14 Strength check, and the creature making the attempt takes 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. The mist can only engulf one Medium or smaller creature at a time.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The cueyatl can breathe air and water.

features.name: Jungle Camouflage
features.description: The cueyatl has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in jungle terrain.

features.name: Slippery

features.name: Standing Leap

1st level (4 slots): bane, cure wounds, protection from evil and good
2nd level (3 slots): hold person, silence, spiritual weapon
3rd level (2 slots): bestow curse, spirit guardians

actions.description: The cueyatl moon priest harnesses moonlight, dispelling magical light in a 30-foot radius. In addition, each hostile creature within 30 feet must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) cold damage on a failed save, and half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that has total cover from the moon priest is not affected.

Cantrips (at will): guidance, poison spray

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage if used with two hands.

monsters.name: Simhamukha
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Magic Weapons
features.description: The simhamukha's weapon attacks are magical.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The simhamukha has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Smite (3/Day)
features.description: When the simhamukha hits a creature with a melee attack, it can choose to deal an additional 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The simhamukha's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: aid, guidance, spiritual weapon
2/day each: confusion, searing smite, thunderous smite

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The simhamukha makes two attacks with its kartika, or one with its kartika and one with its bite.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the simhamukha kills the target by decapitating it.

actions.name: Kartika
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Staff Sweep (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature within 15 feet of the simhamukha must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a success, it takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone.

actions.name: Weird (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The simhamukha draws upon the deepest fears and regrets of the creatures around it, creating illusions visible only to them. Each creature within 40 feet of the simhamukha, must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 11 (2d10) psychic damage on a failure or ending the effect on itself on a success.

monsters.name: Dark Father
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
languages: the languages it knew in life

features.name: Death Waits
features.description: The dark father has disadvantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that has all of its hp.

features.name: Incorporeal Movement
features.description: The dark father can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

features.name: None May Stop Death
features.description: When a creature within 30 feet of a dark father regains hp through any means other than resting, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (1d6) necrotic damage and have disadvantage on its next death saving throw.

features.name: Undead Nature
features.description: A dark father doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack. +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or its hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

actions.name: Final Curtain
actions.description: The dark father targets a corpse it can see within 30 feet that has been dead for no longer than 1 hour. A stream of dark energy flows between the corpse and the dark father. At the end of the dark father's next turn, the dark father absorbs the corpse and it vanishes completely. Any worn items or possessions are unaffected. A corpse destroyed in this manner can't be retrieved other than by a wish spell or similar magic.

reactions.name: Banish Hope
reactions.description: When a spell from the evocation or necromancy school is cast within 30 feet of the dark father, the dark father can counter the spell with a successful ability check. This works like the counterspell spell with a +5 spellcasting ability check, except the dark father must make the ability check no matter the level of the spell.

features.name: Dark Devotion
features.description: The dark eye has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

features.name: Gaze of Shadows
features.description: When a creature that can see the dark eye's eye starts its turn within 30 feet of the dark eye, the dark eye can force it to make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw if the dark eye isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. On a failure, the creature takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage and is incapacitated until the start of its next turn. On a success, the creature takes half the damage and isn't incapacitated. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the dark eye until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the dark eye in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

features.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
features.description: While in sunlight, the dark eye has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dark eye makes two attacks with its dagger.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) cold damage.

features.name: Dark Devotion
features.description: Same as the dark eye.

features.name: Darksight
features.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the dark folk's darkvision.

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.description: The dark servant has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the dark servant's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

features.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
features.description: Same as the dark eye.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dark servant makes two attacks with its sickle.

actions.name: Sickle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

features.name: Dark Devotion
features.description: Same as the dark eye.

features.name: Regeneration
features.description: The dark voice regains 5 hp at the start of its turn if it is in an area of dim light or darkness. The dark voice only dies if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn't regenerate.

features.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
features.description: Same as the dark eye.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dark voice makes two attacks with its mace.

actions.name: Mace
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d10) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Whispers of Shadow (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The dark voice speaks in Umbral, whispering of what it sees beyond the dark. The area within 30 feet of the dark voice becomes dimly lit until the end of the dark voice's next turn. Only sunlight can illuminate the area brightly during this time. Each non-dark folk creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or take 13 (3d8) psychic damage and be frightened until the start of its next turn.

monsters.name: Chemosh, Demon Lord of Conquest
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: Chemosh can breathe air and water.

features.name: Aura of Fury
features.description: The calm emotion spell instantly fails when cast within 60 feet of Chemosh. In addition, any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Chemosh must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or enter a mad rage, attacking the nearest creature it can see until the start of its next turn. At the start of his turn, Chemosh can decide whether this aura is active.

features.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
features.description: If Chemosh fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: Chemosh has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Magic Weapons
features.description: Chemosh's weapon attacks are magical.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
Chemosh's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 19, +11 to hit with spell attacks). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: alter self, create or destroy water
3/day each: crown of madness, fear
1/day each: greater invisibility, teleport

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Chemosh makes three longsword attacks and one shortsword attack, or three longbow attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) slashing damage or 24 (3d10 + 8) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d8) piercing damage. The range and accuracy of Chemosh's arrows are not affected by water.

legendary_actions.name: Longsword
legendary_actions.description: Chemosh makes one longsword attack.

legendary_actions.name: Call Carrion-Eater (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Chemosh summons a vrock at a point within 60 feet of him. The vrock has a swim speed equal to its fly speed. It remains for 1 minute, until it or Chemosh dies, or until Chemosh dismisses it as an action. Chemosh can summon up to three vrocks per day.

legendary_actions.name: Swim
legendary_actions.description: Chemosh swims up to his swim speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

monsters.name: Chittr'k'k, Demon Lord of Rats
monsters.senses: darkvision 120 ft., truesight 60 ft., passive Perception 20

features.name: Fire Dancer
features.description: Whenever Chittr'k'k is subjected to fire or necrotic damage, he takes no damage and instead is unaffected by spells and other magical effects that would impede his movement. This trait works like the freedom of movement spell, except it only lasts for 1 minute.

features.name: Quick Escape
features.description: As a bonus action, Chittr'k'k teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

features.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
features.description: If Chittr'k'k fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Chittr'k'k makes two Soul Bite attacks or three Necrotic Flame attacks.

actions.name: Soul Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Necrotic Flame
actions.description: Ranged Magic Attack: +10 to hit, 120 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

reactions.name: Soul Devouring
reactions.description: When Chittr'k'k or a rattok demon within 120 feet of Chittr'k'k reduces a creature to 0 hp, the demon lord devours that creature's soul. Chittr'k'k gains 19 (3d12) temporary hp and the creature must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or suffer two failed death saving throws.

legendary_actions.name: Soul Bite
legendary_actions.description: Chittr'k'k uses his soul bite attack.

legendary_actions.name: Stumble
legendary_actions.description: Chittr'k'k commands a rat to dash under the feet of a creature within 60 feet, causing it to stumble. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or it drops whatever it is holding and falls prone.

legendary_actions.name: Plague Breath (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Chittr'k'k surrounds himself with hideous vapors from his pipe, a screeching, pestilent mix of damned souls and poison gas. The gas spreads around corners, and its area is lightly obscured. Each creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of Chittr'k'k must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 16 (3d10) necrotic damage and is poisoned. On a success, the creature takes half the damage and is not poisoned. The gas lasts until Chittr'k'k uses this legendary action again or until Chittr'k'k dies. Rats, rattok demons, wind demons, and Chittr'k'k are immune to the effects of Plague Breath.

monsters.name: Rangda, Demon Lord of Witches
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.senses: darkvision 120 ft., truesight 60 ft., passive Perception 19

features.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)

features.name: Magic Resistance

Rangda's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 19, +11 to hit with spell attacks). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: charm person, comprehend languages, eldritch blast (4d10), fly, mage hand, vicious mockery (4d4)
3/day each: bestow curse (8 hours), blight, counterspell, major image, remove curse, tongues, witch bolt (5d12)
1/day each: feeblemind, plane shift, true polymorph

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Rangda makes three attacks: two with her claws and one with her tongue lash.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or become infected with cackle fever. If the target succeeds, it is immune to this effect for 24 hours.

actions.name: Tongue Lash
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or its Strength score is reduced by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest.

actions.name: Hypnotic Sway (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Rangda sways her body and tongue in a mesmerizing rhythm. Each creature of her choice that is within 30 feet of her that can see her must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.description: Rangda magically teleports to an unoccupied space within line of sight. Alternatively, Rangda magically enters her home plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa.

legendary_actions.name: Claw
legendary_actions.description: Rangda makes one claw attack.

legendary_actions.name: Teleport
legendary_actions.description: Rangda uses her Teleport ability.

legendary_actions.name: Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Rangda casts a spell.

legendary_actions.name: Hypnotic Sway (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Rangda uses her Hypnotic Sway ability, if it is available.

monsters.name: Typhon, Father of Monsters
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.description: If Typhon fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: Typhon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

At will: detect magic, major image
3/day each: dispel magic, dominate person, suggestion
1/day each: dominate monster, geas, true polymorph

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Typhon makes three attacks: two with his snake bites and one with his or Enthralling Touch.

actions.name: Snake Bites
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d8 + 10) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the creature takes 11 (2d10) poison damage at the start of its turn. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one creature. Hit: 26 (3d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 20) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the creature is restrained. Typhon has two tails, each of which can grapple only one target.

actions.name: Enthralling Touch
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. Hit: The target is magically cursed. Until the curse ends, the target has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws and all ability checks. The curse lasts until removed by the remove curse spell or other magic.

legendary_actions.name: Snake Bites
legendary_actions.description: Typhon makes one snake bites attack.

legendary_actions.name: Enthrall
legendary_actions.description: Typhon makes one enthralling touch attack.

legendary_actions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Typhon beats his wings. Each creature within 15 feet of Typhon must succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or take 17 (2d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. Typhon can then fly up to half his flying speed.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The cipactli can breathe air and water.

features.name: Underwater Camouflage
features.description: The cipactli has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.

features.name: Water Step
features.description: As a bonus action, the cipactli can liquefy itself, disappearing from its current location and reappearing in an unoccupied space it can see within 20 feet. Its current location and the new location must be connected by water in some way: a stream, ooze, soggy ground, or even runoff from a drain pipe.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The cipactli makes two bite attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is grappled (escape DC 14), and the cipactli uses its Devouring Embrace.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack. +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+ 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Devouring Embrace
actions.description: The cipactli devours a Medium or smaller creature grappled by it. The devoured target is blinded, restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the cipactli, and it takes 14 (4d6) piercing damage at the start of each of the cipactli’s turns as the fiend’s lesser mouths slowly consume it. If the cipactli moves, the devoured target moves with it. The cipactli can only devour one target at a time. A creature, including the devoured target, can take its action to pry the devoured target out of the cipactli’s many jaws by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength check.

actions.name: Ancient Lullaby (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: A cipactli sings a soporific, primordial song of eternal rest and divine repose from its many mouths. Each creature within 100 feet of the cipactli that can hear the song must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or fall asleep and remain unconscious for 10 minutes. A creature awakens if it takes damage or another creature takes an action to wake it. This song has no effect on constructs and undead.

features.name: Aura of Cacophony
features.description: The demon's presence is extremely distracting. Each creature within 100 feet of the echo demon and that can hear it has disadvantage on concentration checks.

actions.name: Iron Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage and if the creature is wearing metal armor, it must make a successful DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be deafened until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Everywhere at Once (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The echo demon teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space. Immediately after teleporting, it can make an iron claws attack with advantage as a bonus action.

actions.name: Echoes of the Abyss (1/Day)
actions.description: The echo demon summons horrible wails from the deep crevasses of the Abyss. Creatures within 60 feet who can hear the wails must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the start of the echo demon's next turn. An affected creature continues hearing the troubling echoes of these cries until it finishes a long rest, and it has disadvantage on Intelligence checks until then.

monsters.name: Fulad-Zereh
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Petrifying Gaze
features.description: When a creature that can see the fulad-zereh's eyes starts its turn within 30 feet of the demon, the fulad-zereh can force it to make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw if the demon isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is instantly petrified. Otherwise, a creature that fails the saving throw begins to turn to stone and is restrained. The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming petrified on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the greater restoration spell or similar magic. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the demon until the start of its next turn, when it can avert is eyes again. If the creature looks at the demon, it must immediately make the save.

features.name: Weeping Acid
features.description: A creature that touches the fulad-zereh or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) acid damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The demon makes two attacks: one with its barbed whip and one with its battleaxe.

actions.name: Barbed Whip
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage, and, if the target is Large or smaller, it is pulled up to 25 feet toward the demon. If the target is a creature other than an undead or a construct, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 5 (1d10) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns as a barb of pure Abyssal energy lodges itself in the wound. Each time the demon hits the barbed target with this attack, the damage dealt by the wound each round increases by 5 (1d10). Any creature can take an action to remove the barb with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Medicine) check. The barb crumbles to dust if the target receives magical healing.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Neophron
monsters.speed: 40 ft. (10 ft., fly 90 ft. in giant vulture form)
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Shapechanger
features.description: The neophron can use its action to polymorph into a Large giant vulture, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

features.name: Keen Sight and Smell
features.description: The neophron has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The neophron has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The neophron makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the neophron, and it takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the neophron's turns. The neophron can only swallow one creature at a time. If a humanoid dies while swallowed, it transforms into a ghast. At the start of its next turn, the neophron regurgitates the ghast into an unoccupied space within 10 feet. The ghast is under the neophron's control and acts immediately after the neophron in the initiative count. If the neophron takes 20 or more damage in a single turn from a creature inside it, the neophron must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the swallowed creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the neophron. If the neophron dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape the corpse by using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

monsters.name: Pishacha
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Shapechanger
features.description: The pishacha can use its action to polymorph into a tiger or a wolf, or back into its true form. Other than its size, its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The pishacha makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Demonic Possession (Recharge 6)
actions.description: One humanoid that the pishacha can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be possessed by the pishacha; the pishacha then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses some control of its body, succumbing to a random short-term madness (see the System Reference Document 5.1) each round for 3d6 rounds. At the end of the 3d6 rounds, the pishacha becomes dormant within the body. While possessing a victim, the pishacha attempts to seize control of the body again every 1d4 hours. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or succumb to another 3d6 round period of random short-term madness. Even if the target succeeds, it is still possessed. If the target is still possessed at the end of a long rest, it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or gain a long-term madness. While possessing a victim, the pishacha can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except those that can turn or repel fiends, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hp, the pishacha ends it as a bonus action, or the pishacha is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. The pishacha can also be forced out if the victim eats a bowl of rice that has been cooked in holy water. When the possession ends, the pishacha reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to possession by the same pishacha for 24 hours after succeeding on the initial saving throw or after the possession ends.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.description: The pishacha magically turns invisible until it attacks or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell).

monsters.name: Plaresh
monsters.senses: blindsight 30 ft. (blind beyond this radius), tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 11

features.name: Grinding Maws
features.description: The plaresh can burrow through harder substances such as wood, stone, or even metal. While doing so its burrow speed is reduced to half, and it creates a cluster of bore holes that leaves the material porous and weak. The material has –5 to its AC and half the usual hp.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The plaresh has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Swarm
features.description: The plaresh can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the plaresh can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny worm. The plaresh can't regain hp or gain temporary hp.

actions.name: Bites
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 14 (4d6) piercing damage, or 7 (2d6) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer. The target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target is wearing nonmagical armor, the armor takes a permanent and cumulative –1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 is destroyed.

actions.name: Infest Corpse (Recharges after a Long Rest)
actions.description: The plaresh targets one dead humanoid in its space. The body is destroyed, and a new plaresh rises from the corpse. The newly created plaresh is free-willed but usually joins its creator.

features.name: Bottled Soul (3/Day)
features.description: As a bonus action, the rattok demon consumes one of the bottled souls in its possession, regaining 7 (2d4 + 2) hp and gaining advantage on all attack rolls and ability checks for 1 round. Any non-fiend who consumes a bottled soul regains 7 (2d4 + 2) hit points and must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is stunned for 1 round and poisoned for 1 hour. On a success, the creature is poisoned for 1 hour.

features.name: Fire Dancer
features.description: Whenever the rattok demon is subjected to fire or necrotic damage, it takes no damage and instead is unaffected by spells and other magical effects that would impede its movement. This trait works like the freedom of movement spell, except it only lasts for 1 minute.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The rattok has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The rattok makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Necrotic Rush (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The rattok unleashes a wave of shadowy versions of itself that fan out and rake dark claws across all creatures within 15 feet. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monsters.name: Spree
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Frothing Rage
features.description: The spree demon has advantage on attacks if it saw another spree demon make a successful attack within the last minute.

features.name: Spree Madness
features.description: If a creature confused by the spree demon's claw attack reduces a target to 0 hp, the confused creature must make a successful DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or gain a short-term madness (see the System Reference Document 5.1). If a creature fails this saving throw again while already suffering from a madness, it gains a long-term madness instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spree demon makes two claw attacks. If both attacks hit the same target, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. While frightened this way, the creature believes it has shrunk to half its normal size. All attacks against the creature do an extra 7 (2d6) psychic damage, and the creature's attacks do half damage. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage, and the creature must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target can't take reactions and must roll a d10 at the start of each of its turns to determine its behavior for that turn for 1 minute. This works like the confusion spell. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

features.name: Keen Smell
features.description: The vellso has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The vellso has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Magic Weapons
features.description: The vellso's weapon attacks are magical.

features.name: Spider Climb
features.description: The vellso can climb surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vellso makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 13 (3d8) necrotic damage and contract the carrion curse disease (see sidebar).

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

features.name: Arrow Bane
features.description: When the wind demon is targeted by an attack or spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll a d6. On a 1 to 5, the attacker has disadvantage on the attack roll. On a 6, the wind demon is unaffected, and the attack is reflected back at the attacker as though it originated from the wind demon, turning the attacker into the target.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The wind demon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wind demon makes two frost claw attacks.

actions.name: Frost Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.

reactions.name: Swift as Frost
reactions.description: After a creature the wind demon can see damages it with an attack, the wind demon can move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Devouring Swarm
features.description: If a creature has three or more yek attached to it from a bite attack at the end of its turn, the creature must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or its Constitution score is reduced by 1d4 as the demons feast upon the creature's flesh.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The yek has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.description: The yek has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the yek's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The yek makes one bite attack and one claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage, and, if the target is Large or smaller, the yek demon attaches to it. While attached, the yek demon can make this attack only against the target and has advantage on the attack roll. The yek demon can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. A creature, including the target, can take its action to detach the yek demon by succeeding on a DC 13 Strength check.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d4 + 3) slashing damage.

monsters.name: Alpha Yek
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The yek has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.description: The yek has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the yek's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The alpha yek makes one bite attack and two claw attacks. It can make a bone shard attack in place of a claw attack if it has a bone shard available.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (4d4 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bone Shard
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage and the target must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a piece of the bone breaks and sticks in the target's wound. The target takes 5 (2d4) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns as long as the bone remains lodged in its wound. A creature, including the target, can take its action to remove the bone by succeeding on a DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check. The bone also falls out of the wound if the target receives magical healing. A yek typically carries 3 (1d6) bone shards, which are destroyed on a successful hit. It can use its action to tear a bone shard from a corpse within 5 feet.

features.name: Damage Vulnerabilities
features.description: radiant

features.name: Bearer of the Ebon Shard
features.description: If using the Midgard setting, add the following trait and the ebon shards, gifts from Camazotz, to the speaker to the darkness: The speaker to the darkness is attuned to the ebon shards and has advantage on saving throws to resist the shards' negative effects. Its spell save DC is 15 and it has a +7 to hit with spell attacks.

features.name: Boon of the Bat
features.description: A creature struck by one of the speaker to the darkness' attacks must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the start of the speaker's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The speaker to the darkness makes two quarterstaff attacks or two sling attacks.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands, plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Drawn from Beyond (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The speaker conjures up to 3 ghasts. The ghasts appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of the speaker that the speaker can see. The ghasts follow the speaker's commands, and it is immune to their Stench. It can't have more than 3 ghasts conjured at one time.

actions.name: Extinguish Light (1/rest)
actions.description: The speaker creates a 15-foot-radius sphere of magical darkness on a point it can see within 60 feet. This darkness works like the darkness spell, except creatures inside it have disadvantage on saving throws and the speaker and its conjured ghasts are unaffected by the darkness.

features.name: Heightened Spell (3/Day)
features.description: As a bonus action, a target of the witch queen's choice within 60 feet of her has disadvantage on its saving throw against her next spell.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The witch queen has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
features.description: While in sunlight, the witch queen has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
The witch queen is an 8th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following wizard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): acid splash, mage hand, message, ray of frost
1st level (4 slots): burning hands, magic missile, sleep
2nd level (3 slots): invisibility, spider climb, suggestion
3rd level (3 slots): blink, fear, lightning bolt
4th level (2 slots): blight, confusion

actions.name: Maddening Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or use its reaction to move up to its speed and make a melee attack against the nearest enemy of the witch queen.

features.name: Blood Frenzy
features.description: The devil shark has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hp.

features.name: Keen Smell
features.description: The devil shark has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The devil shark has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Shark Telepathy
features.description: The devil shark can magically command any shark within 120 feet of it, using a limited telepathy. This command is limited to simple concepts such as "come here," "defend me," or "attack this target."

features.name: Water Breathing
features.description: The devil shark can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 7) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 18).

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The devil shark makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the devil shark, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the devil shark's turns. A devil shark can have two Large, four Medium, or six Small creatures swallowed at a time. If the devil shark takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a swallowed creature, the devil shark must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone within 10 feet of the devil shark. If the devil shark dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Freezing Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The devil shark exhales a 60-foot cone of supernaturally cold water. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 54 (12d8) cold damage and is pushed 20 feet away from the devil shark. On a success, a target takes half the damage but isn't pushed.

monsters.name: Belphegor, Hell's Inventor
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silver

features.name: Builder of Hell
features.description: During a long rest, Belphegor can create three flesh golems or three gorgons. The creatures are made from various fleshy and metal parts stored on Prime. The constructs obey his commands until they are slain or disassemble into pieces after 24 hours.

features.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
features.description: If Belphegor fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Lord of Openings
features.description:
Belphegor retains his humble roots. Creatures in his presence find they don't have full control of their body's orifices. A creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of Belphegor must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or suffer one of the following effects until the end of its next turn (rolled randomly or chosen by the GM):
1  Tears: The creature's eyes swell with tears, causing the creature to become blinded.
2  Vomit: The creature vomits uncontrollably and is considered poisoned and can't speak.
3  Defecation: The creature's insides cramp as it voids its bowels, becoming incapacitated in the process.
4  Discharge of Wax: A thick wax fills the creature's ears, causing the creature to become deafened.

features.name: Magic Weapons
features.description: Belphegor's weapon attacks are magical.

features.name: Pitted Sockets
features.description: Mist swirls in the depths of Belphegor's pit-like eyes. Creatures who look upon Belphegor lose all benefits from their next long rest as they struggle to expel the devil's hollow gaze from their minds.

features.name: Prime
features.description: Belphegor rides a grand, floating palanquin named Prime. This overly complex device-turned-vehicle is immune to damage and can't be the target of spells or effects. It provides the demon lord partial cover from ranged attacks. Belphegor doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when he flies out of an enemy's reach while on Prime. If Belphegor is knocked prone, stunned, or incapacitated while flying on Prime, it will gently set him on the ground and disappear for 1 hour.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Belphegor makes three soul flail attacks.

actions.name: Soul Flail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10ft., one target. Hit: 32 (5d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage and 14 (4d6) fire damage. Each creature trapped in his flail by Form the Chain must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Endless Complexity (1/Day)
actions.description: Belphegor activates the many complexities built atop Prime. All creatures who can see Belphegor must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for 1d4 rounds as fruitless comprehension takes hold of their minds. A creature affected by this ability feels compelled to tinker, conceive, or otherwise invent an overly complex object related to its class and background. Any downtime taken during the next seven days after failing this saving throw is spent toiling on this object until ultimately, nothing comes of it.

reactions.name: Form the Chain
reactions.description: When Belphegor is hit by an attacker he hit with his soul flail in the past minute, the attacker must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or the attack does no damage and the attacker takes the place of a damned soul, teleporting to its location on the flail instantly. The attacker is paralyzed and experiences tremendous psychic suffering as it helps to hold the head of the flail to the handle. At the end of its next turn, it returns to the space it previously occupied or to the nearest unoccupied space. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature can't be affected by Belphegor's Form the Chain again until Belphegor hits it with another Soul Flail attack.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.description: Belphegor moves up to half his speed.

legendary_actions.name: Soul Flail
legendary_actions.description: Belphegor makes one soul flail attack.

monsters.name: Parzelon, King of Secrets
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silver

features.name: Fear Aura
features.description: Any creature hostile to Parzelon that starts its turn within 20 feet of him must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw, unless Parzelon is incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature is frightened until the start of its next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to Parzelon's Fear Aura for the next 24 hours.

features.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
features.description: If Parzelon fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: Parzelon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Magic Weapons
features.description: Parzelon's weapon attacks are magical.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
Parzelon is a 20th-level spellcaster who uses Intelligence as his spellcasting ability (spell save DC 24, +16 to hit with spell attacks). He requires no material components to cast his spells. Parzelon has the following wizard spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, minor illusion, prestidigitation, ray of frost, shocking grasp
1st level (4 slots): charm person, detect magic, disguise self, magic missile, sleep
2nd level (3 slots): darkness, hold person, locate object, suggestion
3rd level (3 slots): bestow curse, clairvoyance, haste, lightning bolt
4th level (3 slots): dimension door, greater invisibility, locate creature, phantasmal killer, polymorph
5th level (3 slots): dominate person, scrying, telekinesis, wall of force
6th level (2 slots): chain lightning, disintegrate

monsters.senses: darkvision 120 ft., truesight 60 ft., passive Perception 16

features.name: Devil's Sight
features.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the spawn's darkvision.

features.name: Keen Smell
features.description: The spawn has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The spawn has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.description: The spawn has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the spawn's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

features.name: Pounce
features.description: If the spawn moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the spawn can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The spawn's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). The spawn of Parzelon can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: disguise self
3/day: expeditious retreat

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spawn of Parzelon makes one bite attack and two claw attacks.

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw

actions.name: Tranquil Roar (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: The spawn emits a dreadfully alluring purr. Each creature within 20 feet of it that can hear it and that isn't a devil must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

features.name: Faultless Tracker
features.description: If the infernal knight is given a quarry by its lord, the knight knows the direction and distance to its quarry as long as the two of them are on the same plane of existence.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The infernal knight has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Magic Weapons
features.description: The infernal knight's weapon attacks are magical.

features.name: Regeneration
features.description: The infernal knight regains 10 hp at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hp.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The infernal knight makes two melee attacks or uses its Hellfire Bolt twice. It can replace one attack with Reave Soul.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage plus 17 (5d6) necrotic damage. A creature hit by the sword must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or suffer disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks based on Strength or Dexterity until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Hellfire Bolt
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) fire damage plus 17 (5d6) necrotic damage. A creature hit must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or its hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

actions.name: Reave Soul (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The infernal knight targets a creature with 0 hp that it can see within 60 feet of it. If the creature is alive, it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or die and have its soul drawn into the infernal knight's greatsword. If the creature is dead and has been dead for less than 1 minute, its soul is automatically captured. When the infernal knight captures a soul, it regains 30 hp, and Reave Soul recharges at the start of its next turn. While a creature's soul is trapped, that creature can't be returned to life by any means short of a wish spell. A banishment spell targeted at the greatsword forces the infernal knight to make a Charisma saving throw against the spell. On a failed save, any souls trapped in the blade are released instead of the spell's normal effect. Trapped souls are also released when the infernal knight dies.

actions.name: Planar Rift (1/Day)
actions.description: The infernal knight magically tears a rift in the fabric of the multiverse. The rift is a portal to a plane of the infernal knight's choice. The portal remains open for 1 hour, during which time any creature can pass through it, moving from one plane to the other. A dispel magic spell targeting the rift can destroy it if the caster succeeds on a DC 18 spellcasting ability check.

features.name: Bound
features.description: The dragon is magically bound to three circlets. As long as the dragon is within 1 mile of a circlet wearer on the same plane of existence, the wearer can communicate telepathically with the dragon. While the dragon is active, the wearers see through its eyes and hear what it hears. During this time, the wearers are deaf and blind with regard to their own senses. If only two circlet wearers are within 1 mile of the active dragon, each hour spent wearing the circlets imposes one level of exhaustion on those wearers. If only a single wearer is within 1 mile of the active dragon, each minute spent wearing the circlet gives that wearer one level of exhaustion. If no circlet wearers are within 1 mile of the dragon, it views all creatures it can see as enemies and tries to destroy them until a circlet wearer communicates with the dragon or the dragon is destroyed. A circlet wearer can use its action to put the dragon in an inactive state where it becomes incapacitated until a wearer uses an action to switch the dragon to active. Each circlet is a magic item that must be attuned.

Flaring Breath. The dragon emits a flash of dazzling light from its maw in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or be blinded. Undead within the area of effect must also make a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw or be turned for 1 minute. Undead of CR 3 or lower who fail the saving throw are instantly destroyed.
